title: Google Expands AI Search Ads Globally
excerpt: Google is rolling out AI Search ads worldwide following its third-quarter earnings report.
body_html:
Google has announced the global expansion of its AI Search ads. The update was shared alongside the third-quarter earnings report from parent company Alphabet.

During the same period, Alphabet reported a 25% year-over-year increase in revenue, reaching $127.6 billion. The global rollout of these AI-driven advertising features coincides with a slowdown in core ad growth.
